page.overview:
Who is Harley?

Harley is a character appearing in , who is a rival of May.

Harley is a tall, slender young man with light skin, long, wavy purple hair and blue eyes. He wears a green hat that is similar to Cacturne's head, a blue shirt that has a cut rectangle which exposes his belly button, a collared jacket and pants that are green in color with a darker zigzag pattern on both of his sides, a white belt with a yellow button and white-heeled shoes.

In , he wears a long black cloak during to give May a weird black rose.

Harley is annoying, arrogant, tricky, flamboyant, cheating, untrustworthy, quirky and jumpy, and certainly not afraid to tell what is on his mind and he is extremely sensitive towards May (who is his initial enemy). He prefers using his eccentric manners to draw the audience's attention. In the English dub, he calls May as his "cute little gingerbread cookie" (which is a rewrite of the line 「ハルカちゃん、ヤッホー!」"Haruka-chan, yoo-hoo/howdy!").
